title: Redemption Value and Award Fee Card, Wanderlane Traveller Club
content:
A point does not carry the same value at every tier of the Wanderlane Traveller Club. Four figures are recorded against each tier: the smallest redemption permitted, in points; the value one point redeems at against a travel booking, in US cents; the fee to change an award booking already made with points, in US dollars; and the fee to cancel an award booking and return the points, in US dollars.

| Tier | Smallest redemption, points | Value of one point, US cents | Award change fee, USD | Award cancel fee, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Wanderlane Blue | 5000 | 0.8 | 95.00 | 125.00 |
| Wanderlane Silver | 4000 | 0.9 | 75.00 | 95.00 |
| Wanderlane Gold | 3000 | 1.0 | 50.00 | 75.00 |
| Wanderlane Platinum | 2000 | 1.15 | 25.00 | 50.00 |
| Wanderlane Titanium | 1000 | 1.3 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Wanderlane Ambassador | 1000 | 1.5 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## How the four figures move against one another

The smallest permitted redemption falls as the tiers rise, from 5000 points at Wanderlane Blue to 1000 points at Wanderlane Titanium and at Wanderlane Ambassador, which share the same figure. The value of a point rises across the same range, from 0.8 US cents at Wanderlane Blue to 1.5 US cents at Wanderlane Ambassador.

Both award fees fall to nothing at Wanderlane Titanium and at Wanderlane Ambassador, where a change carries a fee of 0.00 and a cancellation carries a fee of 0.00. At each tier where either is charged, the cancel fee is the heavier of the two: 125.00 against 95.00 at Wanderlane Blue, 95.00 against 75.00 at Wanderlane Silver, 75.00 against 50.00 at Wanderlane Gold and 50.00 against 25.00 at Wanderlane Platinum.
